meta.title: Interview Dojo
meta.description: Japanese study-abroad interview practice in three steps: target university and major → statement of purpose → generate material. The plugin researches the official website, builds common and school-specific questions, and runs a guided mock interview with Japanese/Chinese text, vocabulary and grammar analysis, per-answer feedback, and voice conversation. During the interview, Japanese and Chinese can be hidden independently. Voice supports live browser recognition and an optional local DSH SenseVoice recording recognizer that keeps audio on the computer. Interviewer speech prefers Edge neural voices (optional dependency, online) and falls back to system speech. Hands-free mode starts listening automatically after each question. One click archives the full transcript, per-question analysis and knowledge list as Word-compatible/Markdown documents, and one click clears the current practice for a fresh session. Open it from the "Interview Dojo" tab above the conversation, the right sidebar "+" → "Interview Dojo", or the button beside the composer. Web search/fetch and an LLM route must be configured first. Questions are inferred from public pages and general patterns, not official past-interview records. Statement text is sent to the configured model and stored in the local data directory plus browser local storage.
